title: New West Maui wells timeline
summary: On September 17, staff presented a timeline for new West Maui wells, which are being developed on overlapping schedules. The Kahana well is projected to finish in the fourth quarter of this year, and the well called H2 in early 2032. Staff said the L1 and H1 wells are fully funded and all four wells will use federal grants or the water system development fund.

boards.name: Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee

timeline.text: Staff said the four wells are a top priority for West Maui residents, for reliable water for fire protection and peak demand.
Staff said all four wells will be funded through federal grants or the department's water system development fund.
Staff said the L1 and H1 wells are fully funded.
The well called H2 is projected to be finished in early 2032.
The Kahana well is projected to be finished in the fourth quarter of this year.
The water department is working on several new West Maui wells on overlapping timelines.
A board member asked to add the West Maui well schedule and desalination report release to a future agenda.
The director said a West Maui well development schedule should be presented in September.
The Department of Water Supply is applying for the wells now.

timeline.text: The administrator said the well project would support about 3,200 housing units.

timeline.text: The County applied for hazard mitigation funds for the well project but did not get them.

timeline.text: The administrator said the wells would bring more water to West Maui for fighting fires and building housing.
